📰 AI Maps Faces Like 3D Topography

Research reveals a paradigm shift from sparse facial landmarks to dense 3D surface manifolds using implicit neural fields. This enables robust, privacy-preserving biometrics that work across pose, expression, and aging — validated on NIST FRVT benchmarks.
